meta.name: Census of India 2011 - state and UT totals (selected fields)
meta.source_org: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (Census of India 2011)
meta.license: Government of India open data (Census of India). Mirror is a third-party compilation of the official tables.
meta.redistributed_via: GitHub mirror nishusharma1608/India-Census-2011-Analysis (file india-districts-census-2011.csv, same file as the Kaggle danofer/india-census dataset). Official censusindia.gov.in tables were not fetched.
meta.limitations: District boundaries are those of 2011 (640 districts). No area, no 0-6 population and no urban population in the source, so literacy is per total population and urban share uses households. Education-level counts cover a subset of persons (see edu_total). Worker-category counts of Senapati (Manipur) do not sum to total workers in the source. Mirror values are not re-checked against the official PCA files, but the national total (1,210,854,977) equals the Census 2011 total. State totals are sums of district counts.
meta.method: Sum each count over the 2011 districts, grouped by the state of today (key = id in data/ref/states.csv). Telangana = 2011 districts Adilabad, Nizamabad, Karimnagar, Medak, Hyderabad, Rangareddy, Mahbubnagar, Nalgonda, Warangal, Khammam; Andhra Pradesh = the other 13 districts of 2011 Andhra Pradesh. Ladakh = Leh and Kargil. Rates recomputed from the summed counts. PCA correction (pipeline/build_census2011_pca.py): households, 0–6 population, urban population, area and official literacy from the PCA district table scraped from censusindia.gov.in (github.com/pigshell/india-census-2011); every pct_hh_* share now uses PCA households.
